decisions.base: Combine 264-card Series 1 and 264-card Series 2 into single 528-card BASE checklist, all numbered subjects equally likely.
decisions.rookies: Use 56 unique TCDB rookie-index entries; RC suffix only on verified Base rookie cards.
decisions.puzzle: One original 3-piece Yogi Berra puzzle panel per pack historically, 21 panels spanning 1-3 through 61-63. Separate INSERT set with oddsPerPack 1; art must use the authentic puzzle panels.
decisions.previews: Exclude 12-card dealer-only Special Preview promos; these were not ordinary pack pulls.
decisions.errors: Do not manufacture error/variation checklists or extra scarcity.
decisions.pack: Four VCS cards per pack, 24 packs per box. Puzzle panel is a separate hit pool from four-card base draw.
decisions.release: DRAFT only; imagery, pricing, grading suitability and pack QA remain outstanding.

productSets.name: Base
productSets.notes: Base #1–528 equally weighted; #1 Leaf Set included as standard collectible.

productSets.name: Yogi Berra Puzzle
productSets.notes: 21 three-piece puzzle panels; original foil packs contained one panel.
